entries.description: The game applies each type-chart row in table order with integer truncation (x5/10 or x20/10 per row, BattleSystem_Divide), so a resisted-then-super-effective dual type (e.g. Fire vs Water/Grass, Ice vs Water/Flying) can lose 1 HP: floor(d/2)*2. Showdown sums effectiveness first and multiplies x2 then /2, so the pair cancels exactly. Game damage <= Showdown by up to 1. Example: Garchomp Flamethrower vs Ludicolo: port/game rolls are even (e.g. 60) where Showdown gives the odd value (61); hand case in damage.test.mjs: 41 -> STAB 61 -> x5/10 = 30 -> x20/10 = 60 (Showdown 61). Also Milotic Ice Beam vs Gyarados.
entries.impact: Showdown resolves real damage (Constitution II), so battle damage can differ from the cartridge by about 1-3 HP on some rolls; the AI's own damage estimate uses the game formula (sim/damage.mjs).

entries.description: Game: a Sniper crit sets criticalMul = 3 and multiplies the base damage before the random roll. Showdown: crit x2 before the roll, then Sniper as a chained x1.5 in the final ModifyDamage step after random, STAB and type. Rolls differ by about 1-3 HP in either direction. Example: Aaron's Drapion (Sniper) crit X-Scissor vs Lucian's Alakazam: port [310,314,318,...,366], Showdown [309,312,318,...,366].
entries.impact: Showdown resolves real damage (Constitution II), so battle damage can differ from the cartridge by about 1-3 HP on some rolls; the AI's own damage estimate uses the game formula (sim/damage.mjs).

entries.description: Game: Expert Belt = damage*(100+20)/100, floored. Showdown: chainModify([4915,4096]) with 4096-based round-to-nearest. Showdown is 1 HP higher on some rolls. Example: Cynthia's Lucario (Expert Belt) Aura Sphere vs Tyranitar: port 321 vs Showdown 322 on the lowest roll (pre-belt 268: game 32160/100 = 321; Showdown (268*4915+2047)>>12 = 322).
entries.impact: Showdown resolves real damage (Constitution II), so battle damage can differ from the cartridge by about 1-3 HP on some rolls; the AI's own damage estimate uses the game formula (sim/damage.mjs).

entries.description: Game applies Filter/Solid Rock (BattleSystem_Divide(d*3,4)) and then Expert Belt (d*120/100) as two separately floored steps. Showdown chains 0.75 and 1.2 into one 4096-based modifier (3686/4096) and rounds once. Showdown 1 HP higher on some rolls. (Filter/Solid Rock alone never diverged: after a x2/x4 the damage is even, where floor and Showdown rounding agree.) Example: Spiritomb (Expert Belt) Shadow Ball vs Lucian's Mr. Mime (Filter): port [80,80,82,...,97], Showdown [81,81,83,...,97].
entries.impact: Showdown resolves real damage (Constitution II), so battle damage can differ from the cartridge by about 1-3 HP on some rolls; the AI's own damage estimate uses the game formula (sim/damage.mjs).

entries.description: Game scales move power with floored integer math at each step (e.g. Dry Skin power*125/100). Showdown applies base-power modifiers through chainModify with 4096-based round-to-nearest. Seen on Dry Skin; any other power modifier whose exact result has a fractional part >= ~0.5 can diverge the same way (type items, Muscle Band/Wise Glasses, Iron Fist, Rivalry, Technician stacks) — not observed in the tested cases for those. Example: Flint's Magmortar Flamethrower (power 95) vs Dry Skin Toxicroak: game power 95*125/100 = 118, Showdown (95*5120+2047)>>12 = 119; rolls port [127..151] vs Showdown [129..153].
entries.impact: Showdown resolves real damage (Constitution II), so battle damage can differ from the cartridge by about 1-3 HP on some rolls; the AI's own damage estimate uses the game formula (sim/damage.mjs).

entries.description: Game multiplies the raw stat by Choice Band/Specs, Huge Power, Hustle, Guts, Marvel Scale, Soul Dew etc. first, and applies the stat-stage fraction last (inside the damage expression). Showdown applies the stage first (calculateStat) and the Modify(Atk|SpA|Def|SpD) multipliers after, rounded. Diverges when a stage is non-zero (seen with -1 Atk; +1 matched in the tested case). Example: Choice Band Garchomp (Atk 238) at -1 Atk: game floor(238*150/100)=357 -> 357*10/15 = 238; Showdown floor(238/1.5)=158 -> modify(158,1.5) = 237. EQ vs Infernape: port [320,326,...,380] vs Showdown [320,324,...,378].
entries.decomp_ref: pokeplatinum/src/battle/battle_lib.c:6724-6729 (Choice items on raw stat), :6950-6956 (stage fraction applied in the damage expression)
entries.showdown_ref: pokemon-showdown/sim/battle-actions.ts:1689-1695 (calculateStat with boosts, then Modify* events), pokemon-showdown/sim/pokemon.ts:583-593, pokemon-showdown/data/items.ts:974-977 (choiceband chainModify(1.5))
entries.impact: Showdown resolves real damage (Constitution II), so battle damage can differ from the cartridge by about 1-3 HP on some rolls; the AI's own damage estimate uses the game formula (sim/damage.mjs).

entries.description: Game: Metronome item damage*(10+turns)/10 in integers. Showdown gen4: damage * (1 + numConsecutive/10) in floating point, floored after Phase2; e.g. 45*1.4 = 62.999... -> 62 where the game gives 63. ANALYTIC ONLY: the battle case tested (2 consecutive) matched; the float error was found by enumerating d=1..4999, n=1..10 (143 differing pairs). Mapping Showdown numConsecutive to the game's metronomeTurns counter is UNVERIFIED. Example: pre-variance damage 45, 4 consecutive uses: game 63, Showdown 62 (analytic).
entries.impact: Showdown resolves real damage (Constitution II), so battle damage can differ from the cartridge by about 1-3 HP on some rolls; the AI's own damage estimate uses the game formula (sim/damage.mjs).

entries.description: Resist berries (Occa ... Chilan). Game: a battle subscript halves the final HP change (DivideVarByValue, rounded toward zero, min 1) when HP is updated, after the Focus Sash/Endure clamp; Counter, Mirror Coat and Shell Bell use the full damage; no trigger on substitute hits. Showdown: halves inside the damage calculation (onSourceModifyDamage, chainModify(0.5)), so Counter/Mirror Coat see the halved damage and the order relative to Focus Sash differs.
entries.decomp_ref: pokeplatinum/res/battle/scripts/subscripts/subscript_type_resist_berry.s:21-22 (Chilan id 35 / super-effective gate), :111 (DivideVarByValue BTLVAR_HP_CALC_TEMP, 2); called from pokeplatinum/res/battle/scripts/subscripts/subscript_update_hp.s:10
entries.showdown_ref: pokemon-showdown/data/items.ts:4347-4366 (occaberry onSourceModifyDamage; the other resist berries follow the same pattern)
entries.impact: Rare: differs only when a resist-berry holder is hit by a super-effective move and then uses Counter/Mirror Coat, holds a Focus Sash-like clamp, or rounding of the halved value differs by 1 HP. Resist berries stay allowed (validation-log 2026-10-07).
entries.test_id: UNTESTED: no battle test exercises the ordering yet

entries.description: Opponent Full Restore is modelled as the project pseudo-move `trainerfullrestore` (priority 7, Status, target self; full HP, cure status and confusion), because Showdown has no bag items. Gap: Showdown's gen4 Taunt disables every Status-category move, so a Taunted opponent cannot use it; in the game Taunt does not stop a trainer's bag item. Other move-only side effects (lastMove for Encore/Disable/Mirror Move/Copycat, Sucker Punch, Pressure, Heal Block) are also open.
entries.impact: PENDING T047 (sim/ai/items.mjs): until then the opponent policy is placeholder-default and never uses Full Restore, so League opponents heal less than on the cartridge (optimistic for the player). Flip to corrected when T047 exempts the pseudo-move from Taunt and tests it.
entries.test_id: sim/test (T047, not written yet); spike sim/spikes/fullrestore.mjs

entries.description: On level-up the game learns a level-up move automatically, with no prompt, when the Pokemon has fewer than 4 moves (Pokemon_LevelUpMove default branch). The spec says always decline new moves. The game layer keeps the moves and flags the event as `auto_learn_in_game`. Showdown never changes move slots after construction.
entries.showdown_ref: pokemon-showdown/sim/pokemon.ts:354 (move slots built once from set.moves)
entries.impact: PENDING USER DECISION (spec conflict). Affects only builds with fewer than 4 moves that level up into a level-up move during the League; such events are reported.

entries.description: Showdown gives every move 3 PP Ups at construction. The game sets trainer mons' max PP with ppUps 0 (Pokemon_Init zeroes the data); the spec (FR-008) gives the player no PP Ups either.
entries.impact: Corrected by sim/team.mjs: every slot of both sides is reset to decomp base PP.
entries.test_id: sim/test/team.test.mjs (Dark Pulse has base PP 15 ... (no PP Ups))

entries.description: Battle stats: Showdown computes them with its own formula (spreadModify/statModify). The game layer overwrites both sides' stats with the decomp formula after construction so no formula or base-stat difference can leak in.
entries.impact: Corrected by sim/team.mjs; the test also shows Showdown's own numbers already agree for every League mon.
entries.test_id: sim/test/team.test.mjs (player builds / every League opponent: Showdown stats == Python calc_stats)

entries.description: Showdown has no in-game trainer AI. The project runs the decomp's AI scripts in an interpreter (research R6): move choice (TrainerAI_Init/EvalMoves/MainSingles), switch and item choice in TrainerAI_PickCommand order.
entries.impact: PENDING T045-T048: opponents currently use `placeholder-default` (Showdown's default choice), which is named in every result and is NOT the game AI. Results are not cartridge-faithful until T045-T048 land; then flip to corrected.

entries.description: The cartridge's battle RNG is a 32-bit LCG (BattleSystem_RandNext); Showdown uses a seeded ChaCha20 (sodium) PRNG, and draws random numbers in a different order and count. Individual battles cannot be reproduced from a cartridge seed.
entries.impact: None on the estimates: results are win-rate distributions over seeded runs (Constitution IV), reproducible from the project seed, not from the cartridge.
